content:
The image shows a soybean stem/pod area with prominent white, cottony/fluffy mycelial growth — classic white mold (Sclerotinia stem rot). The white fluffy fungal growth is visible on the stem and around the pod attachment point. Background leaves show yellowing consistent with a systemic infection. This is the hallmark symptom of White Mold caused by *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*.
